captions_note: the picture drops under the panel, so the reel's normal caption line would land on the face: add the slot with the --caption-y value build.py prints, and the captions ride the panel's lower edge

buyer_folder.name: page
buyer_folder.what: the buyer's own long screenshot to scroll through (one picture, at least 1.5 panels tall)

in_a_reel: T_IN about 1.6 s before the first named word, so the page has time to scroll and zoom. The LIT lines use the speaker's own words
add the slot with fx_add.py --caption-y <the value build.py prints>

the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style (serif_font, sans_font, colours) before the first build; no real product's name or logo in BAR_LEFT or TITLE
steps: edit BAR_LEFT, TITLE, LIT and T_IN in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the panel's place, the caption value, the times and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
